# Nicholas Benson — Full-Stack Software Developer & Brand Designer

> Official AI context, professional background, technical documentation, and portfolio index for Nicholas Benson (Nick Frost).

## Overview

Nicholas Benson is a Full-Stack Software Developer, Engineer, and Visual Brand Designer based in Nigeria. He specializes in building modern web applications, scalable backend APIs, and visual identity systems.

- **Developer Portfolio**: [https://nicholasbenson.cv](https://nicholasbenson.cv)
- **Design Portfolio**: [https://design.nicholasbenson.cv](https://design.nicholasbenson.cv)
- **Primary Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, Golang, PostgreSQL, TailwindCSS
- **Design Stack**: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, CorelDraw, Typography, Brand Identity

---

## Core Software Projects

- [DevPulse](https://nicholasbenson.cv/projects): Developer ecosystem dashboard and engineering metrics platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- [FlowCraft](https://nicholasbenson.cv/projects): Interactive visual workflow builder and automation engine.
- [CloudVault](https://nicholasbenson.cv/projects): Secure cloud asset management system with high-throughput backend services in Go and Fastify.
- [EchoStream](https://nicholasbenson.cv/projects): Real-time collaborative audio and messaging platform built with WebSockets and React.
